Marin Cyclists China Camp Loop

Corte Madera, CA · Road

Marin Cyclists China Camp Loop is a road group ride in Corte Madera, CA. It rolls every Wednesday at 9:00 am from Corte Madera Town Park. About 27 miles, social, no leader.

For visitors

Register for the ride online first. Helmets required. The club cancels if the chance of rain is over 20 percent.

First time? Here's the drill

a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.

About the Marin Cyclists China Camp Loop group ride

A social Wednesday morning loop of 27 miles and about 1,500 feet of climbing to China Camp and back, with a pass through the Cal Park Tunnel and a stop at Rustic Bakery. No leader. The club also runs a Wednesday gravel ride from San Rafael.
